candidateOccurrences.sourceText: They came to the valley of Eshcol, and cut down from there a branch with one cluster of grapes, and they bore it on a staff between two. They also brought some of the pomegranates and figs.
candidateOccurrences.previousContext: They went up by the South, and came to Hebron; and Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, were there. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)
candidateOccurrences.nextContext: That place was called the valley of Eshcol, because of the cluster which the children of Israel cut down from there.
